info.name: Booking App API
info.description: Bo test day du cho booking_app_be: chay tuan tu tu tren xuong (Collection Runner) de xay dung du lieu qua tung buoc - admin -> owner -> chain -> manager -> branch -> staff -> room/amenity/service -> customer -> booking -> report, kem cac test kiem tra phan quyen (AccessGuard). Moi bien duoc luu tu dong vao Collection Variables qua script Tests cua tung request, khong can chinh tay.

item.name: Owner creates Branch (Hotel) under own Chain, assigned to Manager
Login as Manager (confirm hotels[] contains the branch)

exec: pm.test('hotels[] contains our branch', () => pm.expect(d.hotels.some(h => h.id === parseInt(pm.collectionVariables.get('hotelId')))).to.eql(true));
